question_evidence_quote: Miles is going to spend 1/6 of a day reading.
observed_error: The response equates one-sixth of a day with 24 hours.
violated_condition: Reading time in hours must equal (1/6) × 24, not a full day's 24 hours.
error_description: The response converts one-sixth of a day to 24 hours, assigning Miles a full day of reading instead of the specified fraction. This incorrect time relation makes the subsequent eight-hour allocation to each book type too large; the later page calculations consistently propagate that initial error.
